output.brief: The FCR fall is mainly caused by a Finance change (FC-0417, live 14 April) that cut the maximum credit an agent can apply on a call from £100 to £25. Larger billing cases now auto-refer to Billing Resolution. Referrals for billing calls jumped from 7% to 54% in the same week FCR dropped, and referred calls resolve only about 34% on first contact versus 82% for others. Other suspects look weaker: the April intake's FCR tracks the experienced staff's drop, and the tariff and IVR changes don't fit the timing or the data. Complaints rising is likely linked but not proven. Confidence is moderate-high on the Finance cause, lower on the rest. Do not put the September performance plan into effect; it targets the wrong people. Next, trial a revised in-call credit authority with Finance on two teams for six weeks, with post-call sampling, and track FCR and unsupported credits. Ask MI to check referral reasons. Pausing the IVR work is not justified by this evidence.
